label: Gran Turismo 7

support.summary: Built from community documentation and tested with generated data; not yet checked with the real game on this platform.
support.note: Implemented from community protocol docs (Salsa20 written from the published spec; variants A/B/~/C). No lap distance or track id on the wire: distance is integrated from speed (~1% drift), the circuit is recognised from the start/finish line. Synthetic tests only - not yet tested on a real PS5.

transport.summary: Pitwall asks the console for telemetry (heartbeat to UDP 33739); it arrives on UDP 33740.

features.label: Lap times
features.reason: GT7 sends lap times.
features.detail: lap_number: 0x74 lap count (0 = not in a timed lap -> None); current_lap_time_ms: C: 0x15C; A/B/~: derived from ticks since the line crossing; last_lap_time_ms: 0x7C last lap (ms; -1 -> None) (row gt7)

features.label: Sector times
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send sector times.
features.detail: GT7 has no sectors / split times (row gt7)

features.label: Live delta
features.reason: GT7 sends no lap distance: Pitwall works it out from speed (about 1 % drift per lap).
features.detail: lap_distance_m: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing; current_lap_time_ms: C: 0x15C; A/B/~: derived from ticks since the line crossing (row gt7)

features.label: Braking cues
features.reason: GT7 sends no lap distance: Pitwall works it out from speed (about 1 % drift per lap).
features.detail: brake: 0x92 brake 0..255 -> 0..1; speed_kph: 0x4C speed (m/s, abs) x 3.6; lap_distance_m: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing (row gt7)

features.label: Corner coaching
features.reason: GT7 sends no lap distance: Pitwall works it out from speed (about 1 % drift per lap).
features.detail: brake: 0x92 brake 0..255 -> 0..1; throttle: 0x91 throttle 0..255 -> 0..1 (input vs post-TCS output unverified); speed_kph: 0x4C speed (m/s, abs) x 3.6; lap_distance_m: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing (row gt7)

features.label: Track map
features.reason: GT7 sends no lap distance: Pitwall works it out from speed (about 1 % drift per lap).
features.detail: pos_x_m: 0x04 position X (m); pos_z_m: 0x0C position Z (m); lap_distance_m: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing (row gt7)

features.label: Official corner names
features.reason: Pitwall's official corner names cover F1 25 only; GT7 corners are numbered from your laps.
features.detail: no hand-checked track sheet for this game (analysis.track_identity.load_sheets) (row gt7)

features.label: AI field braking model
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send the other cars' positions, so there is no AI field braking model.
features.detail: telemetry covers the player's car only (gt7-protocol.md section 8) (row gt7)

features.label: Flags & marshal zones
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send flags.
features.detail: no sectors, marshal zones or race flags (gt7-protocol.md section 8) (row gt7)

features.label: Fuel
features.reason: GT7 sends a fuel level, but sources disagree on its unit (litres or per cent), so Pitwall doesn't show fuel yet.
features.detail: fuel_litres: 0x44 fuel level, unit conflicting (litres per PDTools, % per GT7Eng): not emitted until a capture settles it; SessionInfo.extra['fuel_fraction'] = level / capacity (row gt7)

features.label: Tyre temperatures
features.reason: GT7 sends tyre temperatures.
features.detail: tyre_surface_temp_c: 0x60..0x6C surface temps, native FL, FR, RL, RR order (row gt7)

features.label: Tyre wear
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send tyre wear.
features.detail: not sent by GT7 (row gt7)

features.label: Tyre pressures
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send tyre pressures.
features.detail: not sent (0xD4..0xF3 is reserved, not pressures) (row gt7)

features.label: Brake temperatures
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send brake temperatures.
features.detail: not sent by GT7 (row gt7)

features.label: Car damage
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send damage.
features.detail: not sent (gt7-protocol.md section 8) (row gt7)

features.label: ERS / hybrid
features.reason: GT7 may send an energy-recovery value of unknown units; Pitwall doesn't read it.
features.detail: ers_store_j: variant ~ 0x150 'energy recovery' (units unknown): not mapped (row gt7)

features.label: DRS
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send DRS.
features.detail: no DRS field in the documented layout (docs/research/gt7-protocol.md) (row gt7)

features.label: Weather
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send weather.
features.detail: GT7 sends time of day only (row gt7)

features.label: Session type & results
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send the session type.
features.detail: not sent by GT7 (row gt7)

features.label: Other cars' data
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send data about the other cars.
features.detail: telemetry covers the player's car only (gt7-protocol.md section 8) (row gt7)

features.label: Race position
features.reason: GT7 sends your race position.
features.detail: race_position: 0x84 when >= 1 (conflicting docs: pre-race grid position vs live position). PS5 recordings 2026-10-11: during races within 1..the field size (0x86) and moving one place at a time - the live position reading - but not yet compared with the game's HUD (row gt7_ps5)

features.label: Penalties & warnings
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send penalties.
features.detail: no penalties or warnings (gt7-protocol.md section 8) (row gt7_ps5)

features.label: Car setup from the game
features.reason: GT7 sends only its gear ratios, not the rest of its car setup, and Pitwall doesn't read them as a setup.
features.detail: setup: only gear ratios are sent (row gt7)

features.reason: Pitwall's car setup recommendations exist for F1 25 only.
features.detail: carsetup.context.F1_GAMES (row gt7)

features.label: Push-to-talk on a wheel button
features.reason: GT7 doesn't send wheel button presses.
features.detail: no wheel-button data (the 0x8E flags are car state) (row gt7)

notes: Community-documented protocol (docs/research/gt7-protocol.md); not yet validated on a real console.

No lap distance in the protocol: integrated from speed x tick time; drifts ~1 %, unanchored until the first start/finish crossing seen while moving (race lap 1 after a standing start has no distance).

No track id: derived from the start/finish crossing position and direction, the lap length and the lap's total turning - a heuristic that separates chicane / no-chicane layouts on synthetic data but is unvalidated on real circuits. A new circuit is learned from two agreeing laps.
Retries without a loading screen (lap counter reset, time-of-day rewind, packet-id restart) start a new session.
Fuel unit conflicting (litres vs %): only the level / capacity fraction is reported.
Requires a heartbeat to the console (UDP 33739) every few seconds; telemetry arrives on UDP 33740.
Synthetic streams carry a marker in reserved bytes 0xD4..0xF3 and are flagged synthetic.

max_rpm.source: 0x8A rev-limiter alert max RPM (approximates the limiter)

steering.source: B/~/C 0x128 wheel angle (rad) / nominal 450 deg half-lock; sign assumed left-positive, cross-checked against C road-wheel angles. Not in variant A

session_time_s.source: derived: packet-id ticks x 1/60 s while not paused

lap_number.source: 0x74 lap count (0 = not in a timed lap -> None)

lap_distance_m.source: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing

current_lap_time_ms.source: C: 0x15C; A/B/~: derived from ticks since the line crossing

race_position.source: 0x84 when >= 1 (conflicting: pre-race grid position vs live position)

tyre_surface_temp_c.source: 0x60..0x6C surface temps, native FL, FR, RL, RR order

fuel_litres.source: 0x44 fuel level, unit conflicting (litres per PDTools, % per GT7Eng): not emitted until a capture settles it; SessionInfo.extra['fuel_fraction'] = level / capacity

fuel_capacity_litres.source: 0x48 fuel capacity, unit conflicting (100 most cars, 5 karts, 0 EVs)

track_id.source: derived heuristic: start/finish position + heading + integrated lap length + total turning; layouts differing by < 1.5 % length and < 40 deg turning can still merge (unvalidated on real data)

track_length_m.source: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; this session's identifying lap(s), never longer than the registry's length

car_id.source: 0x124 car code (corrupted for cars with 9+ gears)

total_laps.source: 0x76 (0 for timed races / free runs -> None)

best_lap_ms.source: 0x78, SessionInfo.extra (GT7Eng: unstable in the raw packet)

tyre_pressure_psi.source: not sent (0xD4..0xF3 is reserved, not pressures)

sector.source: GT7 has no sectors / split times

abs_active.source: no ABS flag; lockups must be inferred from wheel speed

g_lat.source: B sway/heave/surge units unverified - not mapped

yaw_rad.source: 0x1C..0x28 rotation naming conflicting (quaternion vs angles) - not mapped

fuel_kg.source: GT7 reports volume or percent, not mass

weather.source: GT7 sends time of day only

drs_open.source: no DRS field in the documented layout (docs/research/gt7-protocol.md)

track_zones.source: no sectors, marshal zones or race flags (gt7-protocol.md section 8)

field_samples.source: telemetry covers the player's car only (gt7-protocol.md section 8)

buttons.source: no wheel-button data (the 0x8E flags are car state)

_fixture.source: game-selection spec section 9 contract, emitted by src/pitwall/games.py (branch game-selection) from hand-built inputs: no game data, no running server
